name: ShapeShift
rootCause: In April 2016, ShapeShift lost approximately $230,000 in a series of thefts on Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Litecoin hot wallets. The breach began with an insider employee who stole credentials and sold access to an external hacker, who then compromised new infrastructure and private keys, allowing repeated unauthorized withdrawals. A privileged employee stole cryptocurrency and then sold critical access credentials, including private keys and server information, to an external hacker. Insufficient key rotation, lack of auditing, and insecure infrastructure allowed repeated compromise of hot wallets.
